explication: This repository is a collection of Claude skills: Claude loads task-specific instructions and invokes specialized runtimes to produce or inspect artifacts. The principal workflow is user request → Claude skill loading → domain processing → generated document, media, evaluation report, or feedback. Document skills cover DOCX, PDF, PPTX, and XLSX operations; creative skills cover generative art and Slack GIFs; supporting skills evaluate MCP servers, benchmark skills, review outputs, and test web apps. Relationships are limited where sampled source did not prove internal calls.
